title: Guest play fix is not yet verified through the real iPhone user flow
reproduction: Open the deployed KELO WORLD page from a fresh mobile session.
Use the visible Jugar como invitado flow rather than importing internal modules.
Verify the auth gate closes and does not reopen.
Verify gameplay remains available as Guest.
expected: A player can choose Guest, enter gameplay, and remain in the game without the auth gate reappearing.
actual: Guest/session fixes exist in main, but the current real-iPhone automation does not prove the complete visible Guest flow because the BrowserStack context fails before the page is tested.
evidence: Commit 4da93131c1e617168ee904483d4fe1d00cf0f3a8: feat(auth): enable guest play for AI testing
Commit 2c5e55ced94129e8cbe756bbbec503b8705cf37c: feat(auth): load guest play bypass
Commit 92d36bcf4e8ebfaa54f578f2ea608cb1ed2b43b0: fix(auth): keep valid guest sessions inside the game
src/auth/guest-play-bypass.js supports explicit ?guest=1 / ?aiGuest=1 plus valid anonymous sessions

research.summary: The guest bypass/session code has a coherent candidate fix in main, but the target acceptance flow has not been executed on a real iPhone through the visible auth UI. The main uncertainty is verification, not a currently demonstrated new auth defect. BrowserStack session creation is blocked by BUG-0001.

known_facts.statement: Guest bypass/session handling changes are present in main across three identified commits.
The existing World reopen test does not prove the human-visible Jugar como invitado path because it opens Creator Hub programmatically.
evidence: Existing BUG-0002 note before schema v2 migration

known_facts.statement: The BrowserStack real-iPhone workflow currently fails before reaching the page because of BUG-0001.

hypotheses.theory: The current guest session fix correctly keeps a valid anonymous Guest session inside gameplay after the visible Guest action.
hypotheses.why: The relevant session/bypass code and fix commits exist, but the exact target flow has not been independently exercised on the target device.
hypotheses.test_next: Run the exact fresh-session visible Guest flow on real iPhone Safari and confirm the auth gate remains closed during gameplay.

hypotheses.theory: A remaining mobile-only auth/session race may still reopen the gate even though programmatic or desktop paths pass.
hypotheses.why: The target real-device visible flow has not produced acceptance evidence yet.
hypotheses.test_next: Only pursue this if the real-iPhone visible Guest flow fails; capture the exact gate/session transition before editing auth code again.

unknowns.question: Does the deployed visible Jugar como invitado flow remain inside gameplay on a fresh real-iPhone Safari session?
unknowns.why_it_matters: This is the acceptance condition separating a real remaining auth bug from an already-correct candidate blocked only on verification.
unknowns.quickest_test: Fresh real iPhone Safari: visible auth -> tap Jugar como invitado -> gameplay -> wait/navigate enough to prove the gate does not reopen.

attempt_history.goal: Add explicit guest bypass support and preserve valid anonymous Guest sessions inside gameplay.

change.summary: Added Guest bypass/session handling and a fix intended to prevent a valid anonymous session from being thrown back to the auth gate.

validation.environment: Code/local-programmatic coverage; target real-iPhone acceptance not reached
validation.method: Inspect candidate code and existing tests; real-device automation blocked by BUG-0001.
evidence: Existing World test bypasses the visible Guest UI

attempt_history.conclusion: The candidate exists, but no target-device evidence is strong enough to call the player-facing Guest bug verified.

next_best_actions.action: Unblock or bypass BUG-0001 only for verification purposes, then execute the exact visible Guest acceptance flow on a real iPhone Safari session.
next_best_actions.reason: No additional auth rewrite is justified until the existing candidate is tested through the actual player path.
next_best_actions.expected_signal: Guest enters gameplay and the auth gate stays closed; otherwise capture the exact point and state at which it reopens.
next_best_actions.stop_condition: If the target flow passes, move verification toward PASS instead of changing auth code; if it fails, reopen diagnosis with the captured transition as new evidence.

fix.summary: Guest bypass/session handling was added and valid anonymous Guest sessions are intended to stay inside gameplay.

verification.method: Fresh real iPhone Safari E2E: visible auth -> tap Jugar como invitado -> gameplay -> auth gate remains closed.

notes: The existing World reopen test opens Creator Hub programmatically and therefore is not sufficient proof of the human Guest entry flow.
Do not promote to VERIFIED solely from local/desktop tests.
